sample_contract.name: Ribbon Glide: comfortable curiosity
sample_contract.question: Does a quiet, generous effort-and-glide phrase feel alive rather than limp?
beats: her eyes notice a point offscreen right; a small interested head turn follows, then the chest joins
she inclines into a diagonal swim with one rounded tail stroke; elbows softly bend and relaxed palms sweep water backward, then recover closer to the body
she glides right with quiet confidence; the curved tail unfurls into fin follow-through, the hands float to comfortable asymmetric balance, and the curls settle later than the head
she eases to attentive buoyant stillness, a small warm smile and one natural blink; the tail catches up once without repeated bouncing
sample_contract.end: Roshan is calmly attentive toward screen-right, hands relaxed and tail settled.
